description: Raw tag strings dropped before anything else happens - applied to every raw tag and to every part of a split tag, compared by slug (so casing/punctuation variants match). Use this for strings that are structurally valid but never a genre/mood/style (placeholders, 'misc', 'test'). Junk that is only recognisable as junk once you know what other tags exist (an artist name, a record label) belongs in data/3-tags-curated.json's 'junk' list instead.
